Business Analyst — Graduate Programme
Ashcroft Consulting

Our graduate analysts work across client engagements in financial services and
healthcare. You will be staffed on a project within two weeks of joining.

Responsibilities
- Gather and document business requirements from client stakeholders
- Map current and future state business processes
- Build financial models and analyses in Excel
- Prepare client-ready presentations
- Support user acceptance testing

Essential criteria
- Bachelor's degree, 2:1 or equivalent, in any discipline
- Advanced Microsoft Excel
- Exceptional written and verbal communication
- Structured problem solving and analytical thinking
- Willingness to travel to client sites up to three days per week

Desirable
- SQL
- Experience with process mapping tools such as Visio or Lucidchart
- Prior internship in consulting or financial services
- Familiarity with Agile delivery
